balls.text: yorker length ball on middle stump. Tucked to deep square leg and they call for two. Its going to be tight as the throw from the deep comes straight to Coetzee, and he breaks the stumps rapidly. The batter seems to be in and Gujarat Titans finish on 168/6
back of a length ball around off stump. Rashid flat-bats a shot from near his head, sending it to long on for one
yorker on off stump and Shankar successfully digs it out to mid on's right. They want two but that's impossible
length ball on off. Makes room and mistimes a leg-side slap for one
fullish ball around off and he swats a leg-side shot. Mistimed to square leg for a couple and gets back on strike

a stunning catch at deep square leg diving forward! Naman Dhir the fielder there. Coetzee bowls a shin-high full toss around leg and Tewatia tried to dropkick a shot over the leg side. But Dhir covers a lot of ground running in and commits to the forward drive! "I can see the fingers underneath," says the TV umpire, so Tewatia must go
full ball outside leg stump. Tewatia moves further outside leg and swats a shot to deep square leg for a single. Bumrah finishes with 3/14
almost a waist-high full toss on middle stump. Uncomfortably bunted by Vijay to long on for a single
yorker attempted, very nearly succeeds. But Tewatia stays on the back foot and clips it away to the leg side for one
Tewatia gives Bumrah a charge and ends up facing a knee-high full toss around leg stump. Swatted away to deep midwicket for a couple more
yorker length ball searing into his toes on middle stump. Does well to dig it away to the leg side
full ball landing just outside leg stump. Tries to swipe across the line but misses. Hits his pad, but they don't appeal.
escapes with just one. Short ball outside off but with pace taken off. Tewatia is through the hook too early and mistimes to deep midwicket
too short around an off-stump line. Tewatia tries to ramp it but misses. Wide called so the free-hit will continue
oh no That's a yorker, but for Ishan Kishan. Lands at Kishan's shins as this ball slips off and ends up as a head high full toss for Tewatia
this time Tewatia backs away and mows a shot over cover! Doesn't have the legs to go for four but enough to bring up the team 150
delicately played! Length ball outside off. Tewatia backs away and then breaks his wrists in such a manner that he plays a late cut over short third!
thick edge past short third! Backs away to this length ball angling into him. Checks a cut, but in such a manner that he can guide it past short third for four
back of a length ball on off. Wants to pull but hits his body en route to the keeper
picks the screws off this slower ball! Slot ball just outside off and Tewatia climbed onto that delivery, hammering the back-of-the-hand slower ball over the bowler's head
Bumrah: 3-08-3 so far as he ends the over with a full pitched ball on middle stump. Worked off his toes to midwicket
length ball on a fourth-stump line. Tewatia makes some room and tries to pierce the gap behind point. But he fails
full ball on off. Pace off again. Tewatia tentatively drives straight back
full ball on middle, and he flicks it well to the leg side. In fact, too well! Straight to the fielder from deep backward square leg running in. A second diving catch from Tilak tonight
over the stumps to Shankar. Good length ball just outside off and tapped to point

easy for Hardik at mid off running back! Bumrah starts off with the slower ball, fullish on off. Miller wants to loft it over mid off but then cannot change his momentum. Meets the ball too early and the ball pops off the bat's face and lobs towards mid off
full ball wider outside off. Sudharsan moves to the off side to innovate and play a scoop over the leg side. But misses
full ball on his toes, and flicked behind square. Short fine leg does well does to move across and get behind the ball
short of good length ball angling in. Sudharsan clips it off his waist to deep backward square leg
full ball wider outside off stump. Reaches out and drives towards deep extra cover
full ball just outside off. Miller holds his shape and pumps a drive well, through the covers!
Coetzee around the stumps with a slower ball, landing full and wide. Miller stretches out and bunts a shot towards deep cover. Could've gotten a wide run had he left it
that's been swatted away through to square leg for a single
yorker length ball on off stump. Driven to long on for a single
short ball but slower from Hardik. Sudharsan pulls this from top to bottom, sending it away to deep backward square leg
good length ball bit wider outside off. Sudharsan scythes a cut from off the back foot, placing a shot behind point for four
good length ball around off. Miller swivels and pulls along the carpet to cow corner
Hardik around the stumps. Short of good length ball angling into Sai. Nurdled off his waist to the leg side
yorker length ball just outside leg and Sudharsan does well to tuck this searing yorker off his toes to the leg side. Time out!
short of length ball on off and angling across. Sudharsan throws his bat at it, but misses out
stands tall and pulls! Short ball on middle and leg, but Sudharsan is a tall man. Swivels and pulls flat, and hits it just a few metres away from Wood at deep midwicket
good length ball around off and Miller is once again unable to play the bowler aggressively. Ball is bunted behind square
full ball angling into his pads, and he closes the bat's face to flick towards deep backward square leg

Miller dives! He was out if that was a direct hit. Miller was tucked up with a short of good length ball. Ball hits his body and rolls away but they call for a single. Fielder picks up and takes aim at the bowler's end, and Miller was gone had that hit
short ball, pace off. Just outside off. Sudharsan attempts a ramp over Kishan but he's beaten!
big lbw appeal but not given. Low full toss ball around off and Miller fell over a bit while trying to flick. Hits his pad but there was bat involved for sure
short ball around off and he sways away from the line of the ball
slower ball, full on middle. Punchy shot past the non-striker to Hardik at mid-on. He slides to field and do we hear some boos?
around the stumps to Miller. Fullish ball around off and tapped away with soft hands
good length ball cut square for a single

holes out at deep midwicket! And Coetzee celebrates in his trademark fashion with a big roar. Cross-seamed good length ball on off and Omarzai attempts to slog a shot over cow corner. But the leg-side is the bigger side over here at the Narendra Modi Stadium and Tilak composes himself in the deep to close out the catch
full ball around leg stump and he misses a flick. Hits his pad and ball rolls away to square leg. Keeper gives it a chase. Coetzee enquires for lbw but nope
full ball just outside off. Sudharsan takes a step to the off side and plays a punchy drive through the covers for a couple more runs
mistimes a shot towards point where Rohit also misfields, allowing them a single
short of good length on middle. Sudharsan swivels to pull but loses one hand on the bat. Ball squirts away to square leg for a single
short of length ball on middle. Digs it into the pitch. Sudharsan guides a defensive shot towards point
length ball around off. Omarzai clips this gently to deep midwicket, using the wide boundaries over here to comfortably take two

the first six of his IPL career! Full ball, floated wider outside off. Omarzai reaches out and drags a slog shot over the bowler's head. David at long on feels like he's in with a chance for a catch, but the ball evades his fingertips
flatter one. Good length ball around off stump and cut in front of square for a single
good length ball around off. Omarzai comes down the track but toe-ends his heave. Ball dribbles away to the leg side
plays this in the direction of midwicket for a single
swatted away! A flat six behind square leg, sweeping this with ease! Full on leg and Sudharsan smacked it
full ball on off stump. This was slower from Dhir. Gently blocked to the leg side, in the gap, for a single
good length ball worked off his waist to the big gap at square leg, allowing them to pinch two
good length ball around off. Offspin punched off the back foot to long on

slogged but lands safe, and beats the fielder with the spin! Omarzai mistimed a slog sweep in front of square. Deep midwicket and deep square leg get together but the ball lands safe. Coetzee overruns and the ball spins cross him and into the boundary
stays on the back foot and punches this length ball through cover
welcomed with a boundary! Cuts this in front of square with the turn for four
good length ball just outside off. Tapped to the off side
overpitched ball just outside off. Sudharsan plays a punchy shot square through the off side
full ball on middle. Omarzai stays on the leg side of the ball and drives to long off
fullish ball just outside off. Omarzai makes room and attempts a cut. Finds point
full ball on off. Stays on the back foot and clips it to deep square leg
worked off his pad to the leg side
length ball on middle and he clips it off the back foot to keep strike
full ball outside off. Googly driven to long off

this is why IPL teams still back Piyush Chawla! He has the knack of taking wickets and he has delivered with a massive scalp. Chawla lets a quicker one rip, and Gill comes down the track to hit him over long on. But Gill's shot doesn't have the distance and Rohit takes a simple catch on the line
full ball, tosses it a bit more. Sudharsan comes down the track and flicks to wide long on
full ball just outside off. Gill pumps a drive through the covers with a sweet sound off the bat. But protection at deep extra
keeps it on the stumps. Fullish ball on middle, and Sudharsan gets onto the back foot for a cut
poor line, and Kishan fluffs it too! He lets one rip but it lands just outside leg stump. Sudharsan tries the sweep but fails, and Kishan's vision might've been blocked there. Five wides to start
full ball around off. Chops a cut awkwardly, but places it behind square irrespective. Two more to the total
good length ball on a fourth-stump line. Gill cuts it past backward point and calls nice and early for two. Deep cover has a lot of running around to do there
full floaty ball lands just outside leg. Slides further down with Gill pulling out of any shot

flatter ball from wide of the crease, from around the stumps. Gill goes onto the back foot and tucks this straying ball past his waist. Beats Bumrah at short fine leg but he covers up well to keep it down to two
slower through the air. Length ball outside off and turning in. Sudharsan uncomfortably flat-bats a shot past the bowler's right to long off
full ball on off. Sudharsan scurries onto the back foot and flicks this quicker one to midwicket
good length ball outside off. Punched with the turn to long off for a jogging single

full ball on middle and off. Sudharsan tentatively drives past mid off diving to his right. Hardik from cover runs across to keep it down to two. Chawla closes out the powerplay in a quiet manner for Mumbai
good length ball around off. Stays on the back foot and cuts to backward point
good length ball on off stump. Sudharsan mows a back-foot shot down to long on
flat again. Full on middle, and skidding into leg. Gill flicks off the back foot to square leg
flatter delivery. Good length around off and skidding through. Fended off the back foot
good length ball around middle. Wrong'un to start. Flat-bats a shot off the back foot to deep midwicket

high and mighty! Full ball just outside off. Gill gets low, planting his front foot across the line, and then plays a slog sweep beautifully. Placed over square leg, who was inside the circle, making it a relatively safe shot
full ball on middle and leg. Gill presses forward to smother a drive through the leg side but misses. Hits his pad
short ball, fifth-stump line, and Gill doesn't need a second invitation. Cut off the back foot, and slapped in front of square
around the stumps again. Full on middle, and he closes the bat's face before guiding a shot to square leg. Fielder runs square to cut down any chance of one
over the stumps to the left-hander. Full ball just outside off. Turning in. Worked off his pads to the leg side
length ball around off stump. Tucked the legspinner to the off side for a single

And you wonder why he didn't open the bowling! Yorker from wide of the crease, and it is searing into the base of off and middle. Saha is wrongfooted and he cannot bring the bat down in time. The poles light up and Saha is gone.
full ball on off and Saha tries to go across the line and flick square. Inside-edged onto the pad

chipped! Saha tentatively lofts this good length ball, but ensured he was committed enough to do a followthrough. Off the bat's sweet spot, and it lobs over cover for four. This was the slower ball again
short of good length delivery that angles into Saha's body. He rides the bounce and fends from near his chest onto the deck. Ball rolls away towards Bumrah, who picks it up with a smile. Three dots
Bumrah charges in hard but the release is a change-of-pace delivery on a good length. Saha was getting forward to drive but checks it after seeing Bumrah's variation. Fended
short of good length ball angling into middle stump. Doesn't get the bounce that's expected from that length. Fended to the leg side
good length ball around off and Gill ends up working a shot towards cover's right. Saha wants one but Gill turns him down. Decent comeback from Hardik after conceding eight off two balls
good length ball on off. Gill closes the bat's face to knock it leg side. Ball hits the edge of the bat and goes instead to short third
pace-off delivery, good length outside off. Gill taps it to cover
full ball on off stump and he punches an on drive past the stumps to mid on
doubles it up! Slot ball, poor delivery just outside off and Saha has been driving these type of deliveries in the nets for decades! Caressed between cover and mid off!

placed well! Full ball with a dose of width. Saha prods forward to drive but opens the bat's face delicately while driving. Ball flies off the blade and whizzes past the diving backward point fielder for four

a glorious punch to long off! Wood bowls a length ball on middle and Gill stands tall before meeting the ball in a punchy manner. Struck past the non-striker for a boundary! Coetzee with a valiant chase
fullish ball on middle and leg. Swinging into Saha's pads as he tries to flick off his pads. Misses, hits his pad and rolls away
full ball to Saha for the first time. He gets low and forward to drive, but mistimed back. Wood intercepts
fuller to Gill. He fends with hard hands and the ball pops up but lands safe to Wood's right. Ball dribbles away to mid on
back of a length on middle. Saha rides the bounce and taps it gently towards short third for a quick single. Chawla manning that area
good length ball on leg and angling towards off stump. Tucks Saha up, who tiptoes and fends
that's 11 runs from the opening over Length ball outside off stump. Cuts in front of square to cover, but there's a misfield, allowing them two
full ball wider outside off. Gill puts his dancing shoes on to try and hit Hardik over cover. But misses. Kishan and Hardik consider a review for caught-behind but don't eventually
there's the boundary from Gill! Hardik errs by going full on his toes again, and this time Gill clips it very fine, using a flourish of his wrists to ensure the ball goes very fine
Former captain to new captain full ball on his toes and comfortably flicked towards midwicket by Gill. Gill isn't happy that he missed out on some runs
length ball outside off. Saha waits for it and then guides to deep third
good length ball, wide, and going further away. Slaps a cut for a boundary first ball!
Top edge falls short of long leg, but it doesn't matter. Gujarat Titans have won! A tightly fought match and a close, close win for Gujarat Titans, defending 169!
No hat-trick for Umesh, but it's just a single. 140.8kph, squeezed out to the off side for a single

Straight to Rashid Khan at deep midwicket! Short ball angled across him does the trick. Piyush connected with the pull but couldn't get any elevation on it. Rashid catches it just above head height running back and Umesh Yadav is on a hat-trick!

And there ends Hardik's cameo! Short ball, cramping Hardik who goes for a pull and he only manages to top edge it down Tewatia's throat at long-on. He takes a rather simple catch and Hardik has to go.
Slapped away through cover for four! Fast hands from Hardik as he slaps away a 141kph length delivery perfectly in the gap, beating the fielder at cover and giving deep point no chance
Smashed into the stands for six! Classic Hardik. Stays deep in the crease. It's a short ball outside off. He stands tall and slaps it over extra cover. Game on!

Top edge and it's taken! Bouncer on middle at 137kph, Coetzee miscues the pull and it goes high in the air. Spencer claims it, gets under it and holds on to it comfortably. What a brilliant 19th over from him after an expensive start to his debut! Sensational stuff!
Brilliant slower bouncer. Coetzee looks to pull but is cramped for room and the ball goes over the bat
Full around off, Hardik punches it out to mid-off for a quick single
Coetzee can only miscue it along the ground to deep square leg for a single

What a comeback from Spencer Johnson! Tilak flicks it straight to deep backward square! Spencer Johnson is pumped. Sub fielder Abhinav Manohar is pumped. This was full and angling into Tilak who moved across as he looked to flick it, but he can't get the elevation or the placement. Hit straight to the fielder. First IPL wicket for Spencer Johnson!
Tilak Varma hammers it over long-on! Slower ball outside off, but it's in the slot and Tilak fetches it and lofts it into the stands!

Brilliant catch by David Miller! Mohit goes for another slower bouncer, this time cramping David for room. He swivels as he looks to pull and gets it off the top edge. Miller has to run in from deep midwicket and dives forward to grab that. What a big wicket that is!
Slower bouncer outside off again. Stays low and beats the bat as David swipes across the line
Slower bouncer pulled away in front of square leg. Vijay Shankar at deep square leg runs to his left and prevents the four
Nearly takes Mohit's head off! Low full toss outside off and David clobbers it back. It rockets just over him out to long-off
Flicked in the gap! Length ball on off and angling in, David whips it square off the pads perfectly bisecting deep backward square and deep midwicket
Goes for the wide yorker, but gets it too wide. He will have to bowl that again
Goes for the pull and misses! This was a 114.8kph slower ball dug in back of a length. Stays low to beat the bat
Googly outside off, David waits and works it out to long-on for a single. Rashid bowls out without a wicket
Quicker delivery, Tilak pushes it out past Rashid to long-off
Tilak looks for a reverse-sweep and misses. Misses completely with the ball hitting his leg on the way to short fine.
Tilak clips a length ball out to deep wicket, but strangely doesn't take a single. Sends David back

Falls between the fielders! It's full on middle and David goes for a big slog. Doesn't get all of it but it lands between Omarzai and Sai Kishore converging from long-on and deep midwicket. The ball stops upon bouncing. Just a single
Oooh! Lovely legbreak full outside off. David is beaten on the drive
Full outside off, David gets off the mark with a drive to sweeper cover

This time Mohit holds on! The pressure tells. Brevis falls for 46. 108kph delivery dug in short outside off. Brevis flat-bats it straight to Mohit who holds on at waist height. Brevis throws his head up in disgust. Is there a twist still in the waiting?
Slower bouncer again. This time Tilak waits on it before pulling it out to the deep square leg fielder

Tilak looks to go across the stumps to play a scoop. Mohit bowls a slower bouncer and Tilak looks to adjust late. Gets it off the glove and it falls short of Tewatia running to his left from backward square leg
Length ball, pulled away between deep midwicket and deep square leg. Rashid runs to his left and slides to stop the boundary
Length ball on off punched back to the bowler
On a length outside off, blocked to the off side
Tucks a length ball to midwicket
Googly outside off, Brevis punches it out towards backward point. Tilak had set off for the single but has to hurry back
Tossed up full outside off, eased to cover's right for a single
Legbreak on a length on off, Tilak pulls it out between long-on and deep midwicket and that's another two runs for MI
Full around middle and off, Tilak skips out and clips it out towards deep midwicket. Quick running again and they get a brace
Slower ball around off, Brevis clips it out wide of long-on and they run well to get two
Full around off, goes off the pad to the off side. Mohit is up in appeal but that seemed like an inside edge. They don't review. Replay confirms a thick inside edge
Length ball on off, he punches it down the ground towards mid-off for a single
Lucky boundary for Tilak! Mohit angles a length ball across him and he goes chasing with a drive but gets an inside edge that goes past the off stump and races away
Full on off, with pace off, Brevis is smart to wait on it and clip it square on the leg side
Length ball angled across him, flicked out wide of long-on
Tucks a length ball towards fine leg for a quick single. A misfield there gives them a chance for a second, but they decide against it
Length ball angled across Tilak, who bends to get low and cuts it behind the deep point fielder. Umesh does well to prevent the boundary
On a length on middle, Tilak tucks it to midwicket
Length ball around middle and leg, Brevis hangs back and clips it through the vacant square leg area
Full ball outside off, Tilak eases it out to long-off to get off the mark

Rohit misses the sweep and the umpire raises his finger! Full outside off and angling in. Rohit can't connect. Big appeal and given immediately. Rohit reviews it. Was impact outside off? Impact in front of off and that's shown to be crashing into middle stump. No fifty for Rohit Sharma, but a very good knock nonetheless. Sai Kishore also gets his reward for a good spell

Chance gone down! It wasn't very easy but a chance nonetheless. Another slower ball and Rohit is deceived. Rohit ends up pushing it back towards the bowler who was in his follow through and fell over trying to catch it. He seems to have hurt his finger
Full on middle and leg, it holds up in the pitch and Brevis clips it leg side for a single
Length ball outside off, he drives it out through point and they scamper across for a quick single
Pace-off length ball around off, Rohit whips it away to deep square leg
Length ball angled across Brevis, who clips it out to deep midwicket
Length ball outside off, Brevis waits and waits an opens the face of the blade very late to steer it fine of backward point for a boundary
Punches a length ball out to sweeper cover
Inside out over cover and that's another brilliant shot from Brevis! It's tossed up full outside off. Brevis had made room moving leg-side. He gets down on one knee and hammers it away
Full and angled into Brevis, cramping him for room. He digs it out to extra cover
Full outside off, Rohit fetches it from outside off with a sweep to deep backward square
Darted in full on off, Rohit  looks to work it leg side but it pops back to the bowler off the leading edge, although it stayed low
On a length on off, tucked out through midwicket for a single
Full outside off and slashed fine on the off side, just straight of deep third where Sai Kishore puts in a dive but in vain. Rohit and Johnson have a bit of a collision, but they half-hug it out
Taps a length ball to cover for a quick single
Length ball angled across Rohit, who opens his blade to steer it to deep third

Pulled away in front of a hapless deep midwicket fielder! This is a back of length delivery at 145kph, but Rohit looks like he has all the time in the world as he fetches it from outside off and places it perfectly
Dug in short again. This time Brevis steers it out to deep third
Brevis welcomes him with a stunning six! Banged in short and going across him at 137kph. Brevis stands tall and cuts it in front of point
Arm ball on a length around middle and off, he makes room and cuts it out to sweeper cover
Darted in full around middle and leg, Brevis tucks it to midwicket
Full on leg, clipped out to deep square leg's left
Reverse-swept for four! Rohit was ready for it early and Sai Kishore bowls it full around off. This is not a shot he usually plays, but we have seen him use it more frequently in recent times
Angles it into the stumps from wide of the crease, Brevis makes room leg side and punches it out to deep cover
Tossed up slow on a length outside off, Brevis cuts it out to point
Very full outside off, slower in the air. Rohit looks to drive but inside-edges it onto the ground
Just beats Rashid's extended left arm! Length ball outside off, Brevis flat-bats it and just clears Rashid who stuck his arm out. Gets a single to long-off
Darted on a length around off, Rohit clips it out to long-on
Googly outside off, Brevis works it out to long-on
Rashid tosses it up very full on middle and leg, Brevis squeezes it back to the bowler
Glorious no-look six! In the slot and he gets down o none knee and hammers it down the ground. That's a lot of swagger, doing that to Rashid Khan!
Punches a length ball around off to the off side sweeper
Full on middle, Brevis gets it off the inside half as he looks to go big on the leg side. The ball goes to the midwicket fielder
Full on middle, slower in the air, Brevis manages to block
Punched to the right of the bowler. Brevis and Sai Kishore get into a bit of a tangle but the batters manage to complete an easy single

Falls in no man's land! Sai Kishore slows it down as he pitches it around leg stump. Brevis looks to swing it away on the leg side but gets a leading edge that just clears the infield and falls between point and cover running back
Length ball skids on as it goes in with the angle. Brevis misses his flick
Pushed up full around off again, Rohit meets it with a front-foot defence
Full outside off, Rohit defends
Swept just past backward point for four! Full outside off, he got it off the bottom of the bat and it just evaded a diving Spencer Johnson
On a length on middle and leg, Brevis punches it out wide of mid-on
Tossed up full and wide, Brevis reaches out and drives it but straight to the cover fielder
Legbreak on a length outside off, Rohit clips it out to long-on for an easy single
Fuller, outside off, Brevis pushes it out towards cover. This one was at 139.4kph
Length ball outside off angling into Brevis, he blocks it out to the off side
There's that Roit Sharma pull! Only a single, though. Back of length delivery at 135kph, Rohit frees his arm and pulls off the bottom end of the bat to deep midwicket's left
On a length around off at 139kph and angling into Rohit, who tucks it to midwicket
Brevis is hurried by a length ball at 140kph that seams into him. Manages to get it out behind square leg for a single
Glorious timing! Length ball outside off, seaming in. Brevis just punches it with an open blade to get it between point and cover. Both fielders give chase but can't stop it from going for four!
Back of good length delivery outside off at 140kph. Rohit looks to drive but is just beaten on the outside edge
Length ball outside off at 140kph, Rohit defends
That's Rohit Sharma in all his glory! It's full on off and Rohit times that beautifully, flicking it over midwicket and it goes all the way! His first six
Pushes a length ball outtowards cover
Rohit gets a half-volley and puts it away! Full outside off, Rohit hits a gorgeous drive that just beats Gill at mid-off running to his left and putting in a full stretch dive
Length ball outside off angling into Rohit, who taps it down to the leg side

Big appeal for lbw, but the umpire doesn't give it. Gill chooses to review! It's on a length outside off and seams in sharply. Stays low to beat the bat as Dhir looks to swing across the line. Hit on the thigh on his back foot. And that's crashing into middle and leg according to ball tracking! Entertaining cameo comes to an end. And Omarzai ends his second over well after conceding 21 runs off it!
That's gone all the way! Half-volley outside off and he leans into it and lofts it cleanly over long-off for an 86-metre six!
Full outside off, 135.5kph, he taps it towards cover and wants a single, but is sent back by Rohit Sharma
Omarzai strays in his line, bowling it too full and too straight. Naman Dhir whips it off his pads behind square leg for a one-bounce four. Third of the over!
Fires this full and down leg for a wide
Swung away over midwicket! Length ball sits up nicely and Dhir gets forward and gets it over the infield on the leg side
Shot! It's an outswinger full on off, but in Dhir's hitting range. He lofts it down the ground straight of mid-on for his first boundary
There he goes! Skips down the track as Umesh bowls a back of length delivery. He brings out the pull shot and gets it between mid-on and midwicket
Full and wide, Rohit goes chasing after it with an expansive drive away from his body and is beaten on the outside edge
On a length just outside off, Rohit blocks
Oh what a peach! Length ball outside off nips back in and gets an inside edge. Rohit is lucky it goes past the stumps and Saha only deflects it fine and the ball races away for four
Fuller, outside off, Dhir drives to point and gets another quick single
Length ball outside off straightens after pitching. Dhir was early through the shot and misses out
Full outside off, swinging into Dhir, who looks to work it leg side. Comes off the leading edge to mid-off and Dhir gets off the mark with a quick single. Good first over by Omarzai
Full outswinger outside off, Dhir again leaves it alone
Full and wide, Dhir leaves. It's called wide
